title: orchis conopsea subsp. odoratissima
intro: Orchis conopsea subsp. odoratissima, commonly known as the fragrant orchid, is a rare and lesser-known subspecies of the Orchis conopsea plant, belonging to the Orchidaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including its potential to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Orchis conopsea subsp. odoratissima are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. Further research is necessary to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic applications.
